title: The password sign-in page reads whole in vi, de, it, fr, nl and es instead of German labels under English text
steps: S1: node --test the I1 cases of vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords/test/tracy/i18n-catalogue.test.ts.
S2 (by hand on a running gate): curl -H 'Cookie: dshpw_lang=de' <gate>/gateway/login and read <title>, <h1>, the subtitle, the field labels and placeholders.
expect: S1: `I1: the password sign-in page reads in each of the six, never falling back to English` passes: every login key is in each catalogue and differs from English (Italian `Password` excepted), titles keep `Tracy Cowork`, the subtitle keeps `dsh-passwords`.
S2: every string is German: `Anmelden · Tracy Cowork`, `Bei Tracy Cowork anmelden`, `Benutzername`, `Ihr Benutzername`, `Passwort`, `Ihr Passwort`.
evidence: 07/10/2026, desktop app on Mac Studio: dshpw_lang=de on 127.0.0.1 drew `Sign in to Tracy Cowork` over `Benutzername` / `Passwort` / `Anmelden` (dsh-passwords 2.7.7-tracy.3, catalogues held 10 gw.* keys).
fence: The catalogues of the Tracy layer (src/tracy/i18n/locales): the page's eleven words plus its two failure lines (gw.loginFailed, gw.csrfFailed). Not covered: the setup page, AuthError texts that are not in the catalogues, and the rate-limit line upstream writes in Chinese inline (src/gateway.ts, core, not a catalogue key).

tests: I1: the password sign-in page reads in each of the six
